title: Daily Late Charge Rates — Home-Site Lease Tariff
content:
**Tariff: daily late charge on a Home-Site Lease billing period**

The daily late charge on a Home-Site Lease billing period is set by the payments received since the due date of that period's rent charge.

| Payments received on or after the due date | Daily late charge |
|---|---|
| none | 5.00 per day |
| the latest payment, received on or after the due date, is at least half of the period's rent and occupant charges less credits | 2.00 per day |
| the latest payment, received on or after the due date, is smaller than that half | 3.00 per day |

**Notes to the tariff**

1. The latest payment is the single most recent payment received on the lease. A latest payment received before the due date counts as no payment received on or after the due date.
2. Half of the period's charges means half of the period's rent and occupant charges less its rent credits; a payment of exactly that half falls on the 2.00 row.

**Hypothetical period charges of 715.00 (half: 357.50)**

| Latest payment | Received | Daily late charge |
|---|---|---|
| none since the due date | — | 5.00 |
| 357.50 | on the due date | 2.00 |
| 357.49 | three days after the due date | 3.00 |
| 600.00 | the day before the due date | 5.00 (not on or after the due date) |
